global.criterion: Owner-accepted S1-01 compact sculpted premium educational 3D cartoon miniature with believable textures, warm off-white, clear margin; elevated or overhead camera is deliberate for reading diagrams, not photographic reportage.
No rendered words, numbers, arrows, pseudo-text, product/school/Spark identity, logo, brand or watermark.
No person, hand, casualty, live chemical, active treatment, unsafe approach/rescue or universal quantity-based permission.

s103-still-decision.criterion: High map shows harmless practice tray and fully screened unknown container in physically separate bays; a withdrawal path clearly bends away from both without entering the unknown bay.
Near-orthographic whole-site composition and object arrangement are visibly distinct from accepted low decision-video scene; not a still frame/crop of it.

s103-still-absorbent.criterion: Top-down sealed simulation tray has separate stable bottle, tiny harmless-water patch fully enclosed by absorbent ring, and separate unused mock collection tools/closed waste jar; no hands or actual cleaning.
Outside drain-like recess remains behind unbroken raised tray wall, with no liquid path to it.
Overhead instructional cross-section is not the accepted low side-view response video scene.

s103-still-route.criterion: Almost vertical rectangular whole-site map places a fenced hazard at the top and a safe-path junction below; separate enclosed shelter and open assembly options are shown without claiming either always correct.
Large blank attendance board clearly has exactly one empty token slot and a separate coordinator call-point; no hidden or returning person.
Whole-site orthographic plan is visibly different from the earlier three-quarter angled evacuation video island, not a simple crop or recolor.
